item.title: First Palestine Order: SOLA Door Locks for Palestinian Building Hardware Importer
item.description:
Client Background

A building hardware importer based in Palestine, supplying door hardware products to construction companies and hardware retailers across the Palestinian territories. They were looking for a reliable China-based supplier for door lock products suitable for the Middle East construction market.

Challenge

The client needed high-quality door locks that meet Middle Eastern architectural standards and could withstand the local climate conditions. They needed a supplier with competitive pricing, reliable quality control, and experience shipping to the Middle East region. Finding a factory that understands both quality requirements and export logistics was their primary concern.

item.title: Custom Cabinet Hardware Supply for Onitsha Furniture Factory
item.description:
Client Background

A furniture factory in Onitsha, Nigeria, producing high-quality furniture for both residential and commercial markets. They were previously sourcing cabinet hardware from Taiwan.

Challenge

The client was facing high costs and long delivery times (45 days) from their Taiwanese supplier. They needed a more cost-effective and efficient alternative without compromising on quality.

Solution

JH Hardware supplied:

  • 500+ custom cabinet handles
  • 300+ sofa metal legs
  • Direct factory pricing and faster shipping

Results

  • 35% cost reduction compared to previous supplier
  • Delivery time reduced from 45 days to just 20 days
  • Consistent product quality
  • Long-term partnership established, with monthly orders

Testimonial

“We were skeptical about switching suppliers, but JH Hardware exceeded all our expectations. The cost savings and faster delivery have made a huge difference to our business.”
